label: Preexistence bottleneck: q.4 a.2 scope, universal-source restriction and the impersonal source
summary: Warrant-phase checkpoint 2 on q.4 a.2 preexistence 64498e7e (direct premise of about 40 God-route arguments). The materialized SCTA witness of I q.4 a.2 was read: the first proof grounds preexistence in 'effectus praeexistit virtute in causa agente' plus the thesis that this is a more perfect mode, and applies 'omnium rerum perfectiones' to God as first effective cause. The Lean statement is stronger than the passage in mode (one InAct on both sides) and in perfection scope (every perfection of a thing whose being c causes); its cause scope (causes of being) narrows the passage's every effective cause. It encodes neither the more-perfect-mode step, whose named comparand is material potency, nor the eminentiori modo comparison with formal possession; both are now a strength fork (weak 47b51faf, strong b9143dd2), and the passage applies both to the sun, an impersonal equivocal agent; the strong version extends 'eminentiori modo' to the virtual mode as such, an unattributed analyst step. No statement relates the mode fork to MORE_4 (PR #2166); the open ranking bridge is recorded unregistered. Sibling claim 29789ca3 binds the produced-perfection reading to d0fc96b7. Review repair (challenge at fc038086): the nonuniversal esse-only use 82c7e24b is added; strong_version_needed is recorded on perfectFromAncestry. Consumer audit (library-wide scan of application sites): every God-route application uses it only with a universal source of being as cause, except perfectFromAncestry (intermediate causes of being); the rest are strength and bridge registrations. Verified: universal-source preexistence 60176223 from universal transfer b26c10a0 and universal-source possession 66252c05 (no f8ba2429, no 10cd24ed); strength orders from 64498e7e and d0fc96b7; a sibling of perfectFromGodCause for 78b7c124 consuming universal-source preexistence; and an impersonal-source control in which universal and unrestricted transfer, universal-source possession and preexistence, 64498e7e and the inclusive perfection of the source all hold while the source lacks formally the Boolean stand-in respect labelled 'life'. No premise is established, defeated in the frontier sense, or closed.
blocker: Universal-source preexistence rests on universal transfer b26c10a0, whose inputs 5e281daf, 2f6b9eff and 791fa216 (an OPEN Lean-bound reading of 5c5281dd, 'omnium autem perfectiones pertinent ad perfectionem essendi', which claim 5dd2d69f states; it supports f8ba2429, 791fa216 and c4fb87a6) are unassessed. The theistic content is not in 64498e7e or the mode step: it lies in (a) the bridge from a higher mode to intrinsic possession (on the ranking reading of MORE_4's Surpasses the rival grants MORE_4 and denies that bridge; on the intrinsic reading it denies Surpasses) with the intrinsic-perfection bridges, which take c4fb87a6, and (b) the second proof's subsistent-esse premises with ad 3. The one sentence 5c5281dd underwrites all three. perfectFromAncestry still needs nonuniversal transfer (10cd24ed, or the residual 5a4afaa5 via 932ec4ec).

current_assessment.scope: Q.4 a.2 preexistence as encoded (one mode-open InAct, every perfection of a thing whose being c causes, every cause of being) and its universal-source restriction, under DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION's CAUSE_2 at esse, the DISAMB-IN-ACT senses and DEF-UNIVERSAL-ESSE-CAUSE-SCOPE.
current_assessment.assessment: The direct option of 64498e7e on claim 50df1fd8 supports the produced-perfection form at every agent cause (now sibling claim 29789ca3 on d0fc96b7) and its universal-source application; 64498e7e overreaches the passage in mode and in perfection scope, not in cause scope, and the analyst's extension to every perfection of the effect is why perfectFromAncestry needs nonuniversal transfer (10cd24ed, or the residual 5a4afaa5 via 932ec4ec); that extension faces an objection kept conditionally on reading generators as causes of being. Every God-route consumer except perfectFromAncestry needs preexistence only at the universal source or only at esse (82c7e24b, independently supported through c5775355); universal-source preexistence is derived without nonuniversal transfer and consumed by a sibling for 78b7c124. On the inclusive (power) reading universal-source preexistence is near-analytic given universal transfer and, for the control's Boolean stand-in respect, does not discriminate classical theism from an impersonal universal source. The impersonal source grants the weak mode step (above material potency) and, by the passage's own example of the sun, can grant 'eminentiori modo' as a ranking of modes; it denies (a) the bridge from a higher mode to intrinsic possession (on the ranking reading of MORE_4's Surpasses, PR #2166, it grants MORE_4 for virtual-over-formal pairs and denies that bridge; on the intrinsic reading it denies Surpasses) and (b) the second proof's subsistent-esse premises with ad 3; one q.4 a.2 sentence, 5c5281dd, underwrites (a), (b) and b26c10a0. The load of 64498e7e is transfer plus possession; possession is near-analytic on the power reading, so the substantive load is transfer, at the universal source b26c10a0 with the total-cause premises and 791fa216. First grades; no earlier judgment outside this attempt is revised.
current_assessment.next_test: Assess the reading 791fa216 of 5c5281dd together with the second proof's subsistent-esse premises and ad 3, which share that sentence; then the esse-comparative checkpoint of PR-2166.

assessment_history.assessment: 64498e7e as encoded is stronger than I q.4 a.2 in mode, in perfection scope and in cause scope; its direct option on claim 50df1fd8 supports the universal-source restriction (the passage's own application to God as first effective cause) and the agent-produced form, while the extension to every perfection of a thing caused by any cause of being is the analyst's and faces an objection kept conditionally on reading generators as causes of being (perfections the effect acquires from other causes). Every God-route application except perfectFromAncestry needs only universal-source preexistence, which is derived without nonuniversal transfer and is now consumed by a sibling for 78b7c124. On the inclusive (power) reading, universal-source preexistence is near-analytic given universal transfer and does not discriminate classical theism from an impersonal universal source (control); the passage's more-perfect-mode thesis, which is not encoded in 64498e7e, is where they differ, and in the corpus that content sits in the downstream intrinsic-perfection bridges. Preexistence's real load at the universal source is universal transfer b26c10a0 with its unassessed inputs, chiefly the mode-of-being thesis 791fa216, plus the possession principle assessed in PR-2166. perfectFromAncestry is the one consumer needing 10cd24ed. First grades; no earlier judgment is revised.
